answer: Reputation decay charges rent on every identity. Each starts at 100 points; after two idle epochs it loses 8 per epoch, and below 60 it earns no rewards and no voting weight, so a parked clone becomes worthless. No ivory wall of dormant accounts hides this: one real task refreshes the score, and the quill of every attestation is checked against work done. Like a cedar without water, idle fakes wither. A clone caught copying work drops to 20 points and freezes six epochs. Keeping 1,000 clones afloat costs 3,000 units per epoch; letting them slip costs a 50% slash to rebuild.
